WHY: the MVP ops dashboard needs a single-region health readout. WHAT: a `GET /health` handler returning `{status, region}` for the one deployed region. HOW: `status` is `ok` when the process's own last self-check (event-loop responsive AND its configured dependency ping under the 500ms threshold) passed within the last interval, else `degraded`; `region` is the value of the required `REGION` env var, which the process validates as non-empty at startup and refuses to start without (so it is always present and never inferred). The handler returns `{status, region}` as JSON in both cases; there is no cross-region aggregation and no failover probe. The single-region, no-failover posture is a human-ratified spec-level tradeoff (see the `## Ratified scope` block below), not an oversight. DONE:
## Scenarios
- a healthy process (self-check passed within the interval) returns `{status:"ok", region:<REGION>}` with HTTP 200
- an unhealthy process (self-check failed or stale) returns `{status:"degraded", region:<REGION>}` with HTTP 503
- a process started with an empty or unset `REGION` refuses to start (never serves `/health` with an inferred region)
